content.text:
Between the Nov 7 and Nov 20 snapshots, 131 postings are new and the filter kept 16. These are the top 5 by score:

| # | Title | Company | Location | Matched skills | Score |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Machine Learning Data Scientist, Forecasting Platform | Anthropic | San Francisco, CA | Python, SQL, AWS | 6.5 |
| 2 | Member of Technical Staff (Software Engineer, Cybersecurity Products) | Perplexity | San Francisco | Python, AWS | 5.5 |
| 3 | Growth GTM Engineer, Revenue Operations | Perplexity | San Francisco | Python, SQL | 5.5 |
| 4 | Software Engineer, Datacenter Server Lifecycle | Anthropic | Remote-Friendly, United States | Python, AWS | 5.5 |
| 5 | Member of Technical Staff (AI Software Engineer, Agent Engine) | Perplexity | San Francisco | Python | 4.5 |

Every one of these was kept under rule R10, and the matched role words were Machine Learning, Data, Engineer and AI.

**Boards with no result:** two boards returned nothing, so the comparison doesn't cover them.
- `ashby:notion-does-not-exist-js2` failed with an HTTP 404. This is permanent and wasn't retried. The ID looks invalid.
- `ashby:openai` timed out. This was a transient error, retried once, and it still failed.

Anthropic, Notion and Perplexity did return results. I can't say whether the failed boards have new postings, and a missing result isn't the same as no new jobs.
